_doc: Pose / render tuning (model units, degrees). Per-unit override: units/<name>.json "tune": {"poses": {...}}. 'render' constants are global only.

render._doc: BASE_ZOOM = model units -> pixels at 64x80 (bigger = bigger figure); STRIPE_K = officer trouser seam stripe width (cos of half-angle: 0.93 wide .. 0.985 thin); RBOX_ROUND = default rounded-box corner radius (limbs / pelvis roundness).

body._doc: slimming factors applied in voxel.build_figure (1.0 = old chunky body): leg / arm radii, torso+pelvis width (x) and depth (z), shoulder joint x, hip joint x. Global only (read at import).

infantry._doc: Rifleman poses (all values chosen so collide.py reports 0 hits > 1.5). weapon = {pos [x,y,z] in torso frame (x + = left, y up, z forward), yaw (+ = toward left), pitch (+ = muzzle up)}. e_pull = model units the weapon is pulled back toward the body in the E view (group keys: shoot = aim/fire a-c, charge, melee_2, go_prone); e_yaw = extra weapon yaw toward the camera in the E view (prone). shoot.pitch = extra muzzle-up degrees on top of the stance lean. e_swing = [deg, pivot_z, pitch]: E-view yaw (+ muzzle-up pitch, the elevated camera makes a swung muzzle read as pointing down) about the butt (weapon-local z) so the muzzle swings toward the camera instead of sliding the stock into the chest (shoot / melee_2 use it instead of e_pull). Unit-level extra pull for long rifles: units/<name>.json e_pull_extra.

e_long._doc: prone / long-rifle E-view compensation (infantry-guard bolt_rifle_long): std = standard rifle e_pull_extra, slide = model units slid back along the body per extra unit, yaw = extra E yaw deg per extra unit

officer._doc: Officer sabre / pistol poses. Arms are [arm_elev, arm_azim, blade_elev, blade_azim] (degrees; azim 0 = forward, +90 = right, 180 = back). wave_* = sword_wave anim: front views use wave (arm, blade_elev, az0), back views (ne/n) use wave_side; az advances step_deg per frame; twist per frame.

cavalry._doc: Mounted rifleman (bases/cavalry.py). Horse legs per frame: [swing, knee/hock, fetlock] deg (swing + = forward; front knee + = folds back; hind hock + = cannon forward; fetlock + = hoof folds back). neck = deg above horizontal, head = deg below horizontal, pitch = body nose-up deg, air = lift above ground. Rider: seat = seated leg angles; reins = left hand target (torso frame); arms like officer [arm_elev, arm_azim, blade_elev, blade_azim].

gallop._doc: 4 keys: 1 gathered (airborne), 2 hinds land, 3 fronts land / hinds push, 4 leading fore alone, stretched.

pistol._doc: mounted officer (cavalry-officer*): one-handed pistol aim/fire, torso frame like officer.pistol

artillery._doc: Gun crews (bases/artillery.py). Per gun: elev_idle / elev_fire = barrel elevation deg; recoil = barrel slide (model units) at the flash frame; car_back = carriage roll-back; stations = role -> [x, z, yaw deg] in the gun frame (x = gun's left, z = firing direction, yaw + turns the crewman toward his left). dead = lying poses per role. travel = move cycle: pull_z = how far in front of the trail eye the pullers walk, push_x = side offset of pushers.
